description: NaMgCo₂(MoO₅)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-3.00 Å. Mg is bonded to five O atoms to form MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two CoO₆ octahedra, corners with three MoO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two CoO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-62°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.23 Å. There are two inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CoO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-57°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.84 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CoO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent MgO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-69°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.84 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four MoO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent CoO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.49 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to six O atoms to form CoO₆ octahedra that share corners with four MoO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent CoO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.30 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Mg and two Co atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Mg and two Co atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Co atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mo, and one Co atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Mo, and one Co atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Mo, and one Co atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one Mo atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Mo atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mo, and two Co atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Mo and two Co atoms.
